question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH jan_jun_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01'
),
jul_dec_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
),
jan_jun_repeat AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM jan_jun_orders
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
jul_dec_repeat AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM jul_dec_orders
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jan_jun_repeat) AS repeat_customers_jan_jun,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jul_dec_repeat) AS repeat_customers_jul_dec;

action.answer: In January–June 2025, there were 95,048 repeat customers (customers who placed more than one order in that period). In July–December 2025, there were 96,514 repeat customers (evaluated independently for that half-year). July–December 2025 had more repeat customers than January–June 2025. Population: all customers with more than one order in each respective period. Unit: unique customers per half-year. Interpretation: Repeat status is counted separately for each half; the second half of 2025 saw a higher number of repeat customers.
action.reason: Both halves were evaluated independently for repeat status, as requested. The counts show a modest increase in repeat customers in the second half of 2025.
